subject: Intro + demo: Redwood inference for Nimbus Health — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Henry Li <henry.li@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 10 Mar 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo: Redwood inference for Nimbus Health — next steps

Hi Henry,

Thanks again for the time last week — really enjoyed the conversation about your developer platform and the data access constraints you're juggling. Per our discussion, we'd love to set up a short demo (30 minutes) to show how Redwood can reduce per-token cost while keeping latency predictable for line-of-business LLM features.

A few options next week (PT):
- Tue 3/11: 10:00–10:30am
- Wed 3/12: 2:00–2:30pm
- Thu 3/13: 9:00–9:30am

If none of those work, tell me a time window and I’ll coordinate. Attached is a quick 6‑slide overview I promised (Nimbus-Intro-Slides.pdf) and a 1‑page sample mutual action plan we can adapt.

HubSpot link to the company record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/34567

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Nimbus-Intro-Slides.pdf (pptx, 6 slides)
Attachment: mutual_action_plan-draft.docx (docx)

From: Henry Li <henry.li@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Mar 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo: Redwood inference for Nimbus Health — next steps

Marissa —

Appreciate the follow-up and the slides. Unfortunately, we've had a leadership reprioritization this morning: the exec team is redirecting budget toward integrations work for the next two quarters and putting new LLM initiatives on hold.

Given that, we should pause the demo for now. I'm traveling the rest of March and April, and even when I'm back, this project won't be prioritized until at best Q3. Would you be able to check back in early September?

If you have a short 5–10 min asynchronous explainer video or a one-pager we can keep on file, please send it over — it will help when the team re-evaluates.

Apologies for the shift; it's purely a resource/timing issue on our side.

Thanks —
Henry
Principal Product Manager | Nimbus Health
henry.li@nimbushealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Henry Li <henry.li@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Mar 2025 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + demo: Redwood inference for Nimbus Health — next steps

Thanks for the update, Henry — totally understand. I'll mark the opportunity as "nurture" in HubSpot and set a reminder to check back in September.

Quick options so we keep things low-effort on your side:
- I can send a 7–8 minute screen-recorded demo + an executive one-pager this week (will attach the video link and the 1-pager).
- We can tentatively pencil a 30-min slot for the first two weeks of Sept and only confirm if your team is ready.

Which would you prefer? Also copying Aditya from our solutions team to keep him in the loop — he can surface any notes about cost/latency profiles for a quick reference doc.

If helpful, I can also add a short line to the mutual action plan about a tentative Q3 readiness checkpoint so it’s easier for your procurement team to see the timeline when they reopen the initiative.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: proposal-nimbus-v1.pdf (stub — will only send if asked)
